title: Trimble Recognizes Startups Advancing Innovation in Construction Technology
summary: Winners of the 2026 Trimble 0-60 Challenge demonstrated how integrations with Trimble technology can improve connectivity across data, design and field operations WESTMINSTER, Colo., Nov. 23, 2026 —
body_markdown:
Winners of the 2026 Trimble 0-60 Challenge demonstrated how integrations with Trimble technology can improve connectivity across data, design and field operations


WESTMINSTER, Colo., Nov. 23, 2026 —


Trimble announced the winners of its annual 0-60 Challenge, an initiative developed in collaboration with the


[Trimble Ventures](https://www.trimble.com/en/trimble-ventures) corporate venture fund to foster innovation across the built environment. The


[Trimble 0-60 Challenge](https://www.trimble.com/en/our-company/events/dimensions/experiences/0-60-challenge) is an accelerator program that helps startups, entrepreneurs and developers refine and showcase technology solutions addressing challenges in architecture, engineering, construction, asset lifecycle management and field systems.


Ten finalists were selected from a competitive global applicant pool. Each spent three months developing and refining their solutions before presenting them to a live audience at the annual Trimble Dimensions User Conference in Las Vegas.


Three winners were chosen, recognizing startups developing solutions that best extend the value of the Trimble technology ecosystem, including the


[Trimble Connect platform](https://www.trimble.com/en/products/trimble-connect) and Trimble


®


ProjectSight, SketchUp and Tekla solutions. Winners were chosen in three categories: Connected Data, Connected Design and Connected Field or Jobsite. Entries were evaluated against five criteria designed to measure the quality, potential impact and practical application of each solution, with a panel of Trimble judges representing a range of technology disciplines to select the winners.


The Trimble 0-60 Challenge Winners are:


First Place (Connected Design): FORMAS.AI


helps AEC and interior design firms turn sketches, floor plans and existing models into high-quality visuals and editable 3D geometry. It combines leading AI models with precise editing to shorten rework cycles and reduce production time and cost from concept through design development. Designed to work seamlessly alongside Trimble SketchUp and Trimble Connect, it can be accessed directly via the


[Trimble Marketplace](https://marketplace.trimble.com/en/product/873556) .


Second Place (Connected Field):


[Dig™ Robotics](https://digrobotics.com/)


super-powers excavation performance by maximizing bucket and truck loads, cutting fuel usage and providing valuable insights for operators and site managers. Using computer vision and machine learning, it provides real-time guidance to help operators work more efficiently and consistently. The solution offers compatibility with Trimble Earthworks and Trimble Connect.


Third Place (Connected Data): Billy


provides an AI-driven compliance and insurance management platform that automates subcontractor pre-qualification, COI verification, and risk management for general contractors on large-scale construction projects. Available on the Trimble Marketplace, Billy integrates with Trimble


[ProjectSight](https://marketplace.trimble.com/en/product/871552) and Trimble


[Vista](https://marketplace.trimble.com/en/product/775488) workflows.


First, second and third place winners all received cash prizes. The following companies also received special award recognition:


Microsoft Frontier Accelerate Award (Connected Design)


:


[Nomic AI](https://www.nomic.ai/) builds an agentic AI platform designed to accelerate design and construction workflows across the built world, enabling automated document reviews and cross-team execution without compromising data security or permissions. The platform is connected directly with ProjectSight and Trimble Connect.


ArcGIS Innovation Award (Esri) (Connected Data)


:


[ParaMatic Developments](https://developments.paramatic.com/) bridges the software gap in the industrial processing plant sector by developing specialized extensions for the Trimble ecosystem. By expanding Trimble Tekla Structures into a comprehensive, multidisciplinary detailing suite, ParaMatic enables engineers to execute plant layout and design within a single platform. Additionally, its digital twin capability on Trimble Connect links live and historical telemetry directly to 3D BIM objects, empowering owners and operators to virtually monitor, analyze, and optimize plant operations in real time.


Snowflake Peak Innovation Award (Connected Data)


:


[Speckle](https://speckle.systems/) helps AEC firms deliver projects faster and with fewer errors by connecting data from every major CDE and design tool into one governed intelligence layer, where automated QA/QC and AI-powered reporting reduce manual overhead, catch issues early and surface trends across projects. Speckle integrates seamlessly with Trimble Connect (currently in beta), Tekla Structures, Tekla Structural Designer and SketchUp.


HP Award powered by NVIDIA (Connected Field or Jobsite)


:


[Zephr.xyz](http://zephr.xyz/) operates an agentic indoor and outdoor navigation platform that solves positioning failures where GPS signals drop out, enabling turn-by-turn guidance, spatial asset tracking and team coordination for humans and machines across complex build environments. It is integrated with Trimble Mobile Mapping, Trimble Connect and Trimble Connect Mobile.


AWS Scaled Thought Award (Connected Data)


:


[Neuron Factory](https://neuronfactory.ai/) aims to preserve the institutional knowledge from retiring field and preconstruction personnel by leveraging knowledge graph technology. The company provides a platform for preconstruction teams to deeply understand projects, identify conflicts and risks, and track changes across drawings, documents, site maps and more. Neuron Factory’s integration with Trimble Connect and is currently available on the


[Trimble Marketplace](https://marketplace.trimble.com/en/product/874091) , and a Trimble ProjectSight integration in development.


“The Trimble 0-60 Challenge provides an opportunity for startups and entrepreneurs to develop innovative solutions that address some of the most pressing challenges facing the built environment industries,” said Chris Peppler, senior vice president of platform and ecosystem at Trimble. “By integrating with the Trimble Connect platform and technology, these companies are finding new ways to connect work processes, improve efficiency and put cutting-edge technologies like AI to practical use. We’re proud to support their development and excited to see how their solutions continue to evolve and deliver value across the industry.”


Integrations built by FORMAS.AI, Billy and Neuron Factory are now available on the


[Trimble Marketplace](https://marketplace.trimble.com/en-US/home) , a centralized online catalog of more than 150 pre-built and verified integrations, applications and extensions designed to extend Trimble connectivity to leading third-party software.


The Trimble 0-60 Challenge is organized in collaboration with Trimble Ventures, Trimble's corporate venture fund dedicated to supporting entrepreneurs developing innovative technologies. In addition to financial investment, Trimble Ventures provides access to industry knowledge and expertise to help emerging companies strengthen their solutions, advance go-to-market strategies and bring new technologies to market across construction, transportation, geospatial and other industries Trimble serves.


About Trimble


Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress. For more information about Trimble, visit:


[www.trimble.com](https://www.trimble.com/) .
